para_trans: On implementation of Mukhyamantri Samriddhi Panchayat Raj Abhiyan in the state.
Government Corrigendum No: MoSPA-2025 / Q.No.152, -1266333 / Yo-11
Read: Department of Rural Development, Government Decision No: MoSPA-2025 / Q. No. 152,6-1123057 Yo-11

In order to encourage and enhance the efficiency of Gram Panchayats functioning primarily as local self-government institutions in rural areas, the Government has approved the implementation of "Mukhyamantri Samriddhi Panchayati Raj Abhiyan," an award campaign for promotion of Gram Panchayats, Panchayat Samitis and Zila Parishads doing excellent work at four levels - Taluka, District, Revenue Division and State from this financial year.

2. In the State Level Control Committee in Paragraph 5 of the said Government Decision, in A.No.15, M. The President, Adarsh Gram Concept Committee, State of Maharashtra should be replaced by "Ma. Shri Popatrao Pawar, Working President, Adarsh Gram Concept Committee, State of Maharashtra." Also, Annexure "B" to the Government Decision in Paragraph 3, A. No. 8 of the Division Level Evaluation Committee should be read as "Office of the Additional Commissioner (Development), Divisional Commissioner" instead of Office of the Deputy Commissioner (Development), Divisional Commissioner.
3. This Government Refinance Sheet is issued by the Government of Maharashtra with the code www.maharashtra.gov.in: "On the spot."
